content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius city district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property the applicant was awarded a vehicle and shares in several companies while the defendant was awarded shares in the same companies the court also determined the ownership of money in a deposit account and recognized the personal liabilities of both parties the court ordered the applicant to compensate the defendant for the shares and the defendant to compensate the applicant for the vehicle the court addressed various aspects of the case including the division of property and debts the use of personal funds and the nullification of certain promissory notes the court allowed the applicant to proceed with the dissolution of the marriage and found the defendant at fault for the separation both parties will keep their current surnames other claims were dismissed
